The stunningly appointed Minnewaska Lodge offers 26 uniquely designed guest rooms, some with cathedral ceilings, and others with private balconies featuring spectacular cliff and forest views. Our location at the base of the Shawangunk Mountains provides guests the opportunity to witness this awe-inspiring setting from the coziness of their own rooms.
Enjoy watching the morning sun illuminate the sheer 1,200-foot cliff face of the “Gunks” Mountain range on the deck of the Lodge’s Great Room, or relax indoors in one of our comfortable chairs near the warmth of our Vermont Castings stove. 
Whether you are seeking an escape or participating in a meeting or special event, Minnewaska Lodge is equipped with either a spacious desk or a round table and chairs, photographs by local artists, high-speed Internet, and cable television to keep you current with events at home.

Celebrate a special occasion in the Lodge’s beautifully appointed one bedroom suite, with the most spectacular, breathtaking cliff views. Our suite is the pinnacle of New Paltz accommodations, featuring a separate living room and private bluestone patio.

name: Lakeside Oasis
address: 780 Daisy Lane,  Big Bear Lake, California, United States
description:
Peaceful, Serene, Calm. These are just a few words that describe the wonderful location of Lakeside Oasis. This 2800 sq. ft, 3 bedroom, 4 bath custom home is spacious and newly furnished, and ready to become your home away from home! Enjoy sunrise to sunset lake views from the large decks and be only minutes from everything that Big Bear has to offer - all year long!

Step inside, drop your gear, and get ready for fun and relaxation. With plenty of seating for everyone, the large great room is the ideal place to put your feet up after a day on the lake or slopes! Watch the big game or latest movie, snuggle up next to the cozy fireplace, or enjoy a night of fun and games with family and friends. Whip up a feast in the well-equipped kitchen and gather everyone together to share a meal at the table. As a bonus, everywhere you sit has an incredible lake view!

Need a little more space? The separate, large family room has even more comfy seating and another huge TV. There is a full bathroom on this main floor plus a laundry room for your convenience. Step out one of the the sliders onto the large deck where the lake and marina views open up. Grill up some steaks, take in some fresh air, or relax in the spa under the stars. You will enjoy the quiet seclusion here with no neighbors close by and nothing but mountain beauty to look at!

Upstairs you will find three bedrooms and three bathrooms. The master bedroom has a luxurious king bed, plus a dual-reclining loveseat and TV to enjoy before turning in. Step outside onto your private balcony and watch the sunrise with your morning coffee or sip a glass of wine before bed. The attached bathroom features two sinks, a large tub with air jets, and a separate shower. In the guest bedroom, you will find another king bed and TV and this bedroom has direct access to a full bathroom. In the final bedroom you will find three sets of log bunk beds - two sets are twin over full and one is twin over twin. There is a TV in this room as well - the perfect place for all the kids! A third full bathroom on this floor is just next door so no bedroom has to share a bath.

Lakeside Oasis is a special home in an incredible setting and is a wonderful place to escape the stresses of everyday life. The warm, mountain decor, and endless views will make your stay in Big Bear one to remember! Book today!!

description:
Walk to Lake and close to Village. Pool Table & Dog Friendly! 3 bedrooms/3 baths.



When you want to get away…but not be far from it all or without modern conveniences, come to Blissful Pines. Ideal for all-season fun among the pine trees, this single story home has easy street level access and is ready to enjoy. It is dog friendly, and there is a fenced yard directly out the back door.



Located a very short walk to the lake and Holloway’s Marina for paddleboarding, boating and more, close to all the action in the Village, and a quick jaunt to the slopes, Blissful Pines is the ideal family getaway all four seasons of the year!

Bring your favorite coffee pods for the Keurig machine (there’s also a French press and tea kettle if you’d prefer). With two separate king bed suites, a guest room with queen bed and a lay-flat sofa, plus a game room featuring a pool table and an Xbox One, Blissful Pines has a great set up for families or two couples and kids. You will love the contemporary furnishings and luxurious bedding. There are three bathrooms available including one with a shower, one with a shower-tub combo, and one with a relaxing jetted tub and shower combo.



It’s time to relax at Blissful Pines!

address: 746 Talmadge Rd,  Big Bear Lake, California, United States
description:
LOCATION is Amazing! StoneHauz was built in 1926! It's a REAL CABIN! Walk to the Village (.6 miles away), BB Brewery (120 steps!) & lake (.4 miles)! Alpine Slide (.2 miles). Beautiful Views, surrounded by trees and nature! Large stone fireplace in living room, 2 private bedrooms (one of the bedrooms has a bunk bed). NO PETS ALLOWED.

This 1926 Cabin was built in 1926 by the Mason's and was owned and lived in by the president of this society. The Cabin has been newly remodeled inside, and we are very excited about the improvements. The first bedroom has a queen bed and you can see the beautiful stone fire place from bed if you want to leave the door open. The second bedroom has a bunk bed (top bunk twin and bottom bunk is a queen) this room is down the hall on the opposite side of the home, giving some privacy between the two rooms. This second bedroom step down (4 stairs) into a den like atmosphere, where the entire room from floor to ceiling have been completely redone. Living room has a large natural stone fireplace, (bring some firewood). This cabin is located approximately 1/2 a mile from the village and the lake. The Alpine slide (roller coaster, zipline and more) is just across the blvd and the Big Bear Brewery and Azteca Mexican Food restaurant are a quick walk away. There is also a small market about 1/3 mile away. Perfect location and a real cabin to enjoy. This is a large property, over 11,000 square feet. This property is fenced, and is just one lot space away from Big Bear Blvd.

Full and private access to the house and private hot tub for you to enjoy.
